cases.subject: Maths
cases.heading: Have I checked every possible case?
cases.do: List the cases first, solve each one, then combine the valid answers.
cases.ask_this_when_you_see: modulus, roots, a graph, or a piecewise rule

cases.subject: Physics
cases.heading: Have I fixed the direction before using signs?
cases.do: Draw the positive direction and label every vector before writing equations.
cases.ask_this_when_you_see: directions, components, forces, fields, or motion

cases.subject: Chemistry
cases.heading: Which condition controls this reaction?
cases.do: Circle the reagent and condition, then write the rule they activate.
cases.ask_this_when_you_see: a reagent, temperature, medium, exception, or named reaction

cases.subject: Maths
cases.rejection_reason: The questions share a chapter but need different preventive actions.
